notes:
1. Fixed Windows update installation failing before the updater helper could start in IL2CPP players.
2. Includes the 1.0.3.1 restoration of Solo Gates, Training & Challenges, Forbidden Memories and Link Evolution content.
3. Existing settings, decks, adventure progress and WCS2006 puzzles are preserved.
4. If Windows 1.0.3 or 1.0.3.1 reports FileVersionInfo during installation, close the game, extract the recovery ZIP beside MDPro4.exe, run Repair-Windows-1.0.3-Updater.cmd, then reopen and update: https://updates.elderlich.com/patches/windows/MDPro4-windows-1.0.3-updater-recovery.zip
